about.body: The B47 is BMW's modular turbocharged 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engine, in production since 2014. It's one of the most widely-used diesel engines in the current BMW range, fitted across 10 different models from the 1 Series up to the X5. The B47 is the direct successor to the N47 engine — sharing the same displacement but featuring a redesigned timing chain system and other internal improvements aimed at increasing reliability.

byModel.body: In the **1 Series**, the B47 is the diesel option for the 116d, 118d, and 120d (F20/F21, 2015–2019). The **2 Series** uses it in the 218d and 220d (F22/F23). The **3 Series** F30/F31 models (2015–2019) use it in the 316d, 318d, and 320d. The **4 Series** F32/F33/F36 (2015–2020) uses it in the 418d and 420d. The **5 Series** G30/G31 (2016–2023) uses it in the 518d and 520d. Across the SUV range, the B47 appears in the **X1** (F48) and **X2** (F39) across multiple sDrive/xDrive variants, the **X3** (G01) as the xDrive20d, the **X4** (G02) as the xDrive20d, and the **X5** (G05) as the xDrive30d in early models.

compatibility.body: Because the B47 spans 10 different models and multiple generations, compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation, and drivetrain spec, which we do by registration. A B47 from a 1 Series isn't a drop-in match for a B47 from an X5, even though it's the same base engine code — ancillaries, mounting, and drivetrain integration all differ. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle.
